experiment.scope: Reset-synthesis causal-window wrapper, not stateful streaming WORLD. Release clock starts at preprocessed 48 kHz input. Native timings exclude resampling, RMS matching and artifact I/O. Listening levels use whole-clip normalization, not a proposed live gain algorithm.
